changes: Hold PERF and turn a knob to lock QPER's linked performance; YES, PLAY, RECORD and STOP apply, clear, copy and paste it.
QPER keeps only its link (QPER + a pad); its other gestures are stock's again.
Hold CHRO and turn a knob to link aftertouch; SAMPLER is stock's again.
SCENE + YES writes the scene into the kit; YES again undoes. With SCENE or PERF held, PLAY no longer starts the sequencer.
LIVE RECORDING keeps scene changes too: RECORD + YES writes them as locks, RECORD + NO clears them.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
